RCSP-134.feature: Inventory - Vendor Items (DB vs UI validation)
RCSP-134.description: Verify Vendor Item Name and Unit Cost displayed in the Vendor Items UI match PostgreSQL database values for Vendor ID 2 and Vendor ID 3 (latest record per item).

prerequisites: User has valid Back Office access
User can access Vendor Items page
Switch to WB Unit 1034 via My Hierarchy before navigating to Vendor Items

testCases.testName: Verify whether vendor item name and unit cost displayed in Vendor Items UI match the database values for Vendor ID 2
Verify whether all vendor item records returned from the database are displayed in Vendor Items UI for Vendor ID 2
Verify whether the latest vendor item name and unit cost for each item match the database values for Vendor ID 3
Verify whether the latest vendor item record is selected when multiple vendor item records exist for the same item for Vendor ID 3
Verify whether vendor item records with null available_from or expires_at are excluded from the Vendor ID 3 validation
Verify whether Vendor Item Name is correctly displayed for all Vendor ID 2 records based on database values
Verify whether Unit Cost is correctly displayed for all Vendor ID 2 records based on database values
Verify whether Vendor Item Name is correctly displayed for the latest Vendor ID 3 records
Verify whether Unit Cost is correctly displayed for the latest Vendor ID 3 records
